name: Long Task
description: Simulate a long-running task: sleeps for the requested duration while reporting progress at intervals and checking cooperative-cancel checkpoints. Set ignore_cancel=true to simulate an uncooperative plugin (main process force-kills after the 5s grace period).

ignore_cancel.description: Skip cancel checkpoints (simulates an uncooperative plugin; used to verify the main-process grace-period force-kill path). Defaults to false.

progress_interval_ms.description: Interval between progress reports in milliseconds. Defaults to 1000.

slept_ms.description: Actual elapsed time in milliseconds when the task returned

name: Greeting
description: Declarative config reference (P-002): assembles a greeting from plugin config (greeting_name / style / exclaim / repeat_times) declared in manifest contributes.configuration. Input name overrides the configured greeting_name. Requires the secret api_token to be configured in the workbench plugin settings panel (unconfigured calls fail with guidance on where to configure it). The token value is never echoed back.

name.description: Overrides the configured greeting_name for this call.

config_used.description: Echo of the non-secret config values actually applied

token_status.description: Status of the secret api_token (value is never returned)

name: UI Push Test
description: Micro-app push reference (P-003): pushes a message to the plugin's micro-app window via ctx.ui.send. The window must be open first (click 打开界面 on the workbench plugin card); when the window is closed the call fails with 40010 PLUGIN_UI_NOT_OPEN along with guidance the Agent can relay to the user. The pushed payload ({kind, message, sent_at}) renders in the window's message list.

message.description: Message text to push. Defaults to an auto-generated timestamped message.

delivered.description: True when the push was handed off to the open window

payload.description: The exact payload delivered to the window (echo for verification)
